notes.title: Seriously brutal roguelike, out now, is like a gruesome new Dark Souls
notes.content:
My favorite part of Dark Souls 1 is the fact you're essentially playing as a walking, decaying, tired old reanimated corpse. This is a game about struggle, fatigue, dragging yourself forward despite the crushing burdens of battle. How fitting that you play a cadaverous former warrior, barely held together by dark magic and a suit of armor - the perfect metaphor for a decrepit, erstwhile world, clinging to the bitter embers of life. You take that mood, mix it with the party-based combat of Diablo 4 or Darkest Dungeon, and inject some seriously brutal kills and gore. Available now, in full 1.0 glory, this is a seriously nasty roguelike.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Corpse Keeper Version 1.0 Out Now! 40% OFF!
notes.content:
Hi guys! We are very excited to announce that Corpse Keeper has officially left Early Access and version 1.0 is out now! To celebrate the launch, we have decided to have a 40% off launch discount for the next two weeks. Get on board while it lasts!

In this major update, a new difficulty level has been added into the game. Here you will have the chance to encounter apostles from the Golden City and confront the ultimate demon. Other than that, we have added a bunch of adjustments to improve your gaming experience.

[b]System Updates:[/b]
[olist]
[*] The game is now playable on Steam Deck.
[*] When the total amount of Blood poured into the Blood Altar reaches a certain threshold, the "Corpse Activity" option will be added to the Ossuary - Coffin - Corpse Management Interface. You can pour in Blood to reduce the cooldown time for the selected character's Soul Crystal usage. The effect of Physical Activation is similar to preservatives and lasts for the duration of each exploration.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304240/24ab5ab19f07a9b4a095bc39392868439278f4f2.png[/img]
[*] Starting from the 4-Crystal difficulty, a new category of equipment called the "Exclusive Weapon" has been added. These weapons can only be used by specific characters, do not provide armor, but will offer additional Attack.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304240/f3b95a0d079af0600f3145c80a48bd8ed3dc62fb.png[/img]
[*] The number of Skulls required to enhance a Corpse's depth of Memories of Bones at the Bonfire has been reduced.
[*] Items will no longer be lost when carrying Guardian Stones to teleport back to the Ossuary, regardless of whether an emergency escape is used.
[*] You can now loot Scout Skulls from Elite Scout.
[*] The drop rate for Blood has been increased.
[*] The stack limits for certain items have been increased:
Skulls: 2 → 3
Gold: 2 → 3
Blood: 10 → 15
Guardian Stones: 2 → 3
Pickaxes: 1 → 2
[/olist]
[b]Combat Adjustments:[/b]
[olist]
[*] The difficulty curve for Heroes has been adjusted. Heroes will be a bit easier to conquer before 3-Crystal difficulty, and more challenging at 4-Crystal and 5-Crystal difficulty levels.
[*] Increased players' Magic Damage dealt.
[*] Players' Inspiration Strike will no longer be interrupted by normal attacks.
[*] Resilience bonuses for slow actions have been increased. Before 3-Crystal difficulty, enemies do not benefit from this bonus, but starting from 3-Crystal difficulty, enemies will also have a slight benefit from this effect.
[*] The Vagrant Knight's attack speed will increase with consecutive hits, with a maximum increase of approximately 20%.
[*] The quadruple hit damage of the Templar Knight in the Counsellor's Hidden Chamber has been decreased.
[/olist]
[b]Optimizations:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Optimized the tutorial of the game.
[*] Improved the display of the item quantities.
[*] The default intensity of part of the visual effects has been lowered.
[/olist]

Due to the extensive adjustments and updates made to the game over the past year, the current demo no longer fully represents the full game's quality and gameplay. Therefore, we have decided to remove the demo.

Thanks all for your support! If you have any questions, bug reports, or suggestions, please be sure to join our Discord server: http://discord.gg/yKSBjxep7Z.

notes.title: This dark fantasy action roguelike has my attention, and a free demo
notes.content:
One of the greatest strengths of the Dark Souls series is just how satisfying its baseline combat feels. Right from those early moments in the Undead Asylum, I was hooked by the swordplay long before I'd experienced its world and story. Having played the free Steam demo for upcoming action roguelike Corpse Keeper, which adopts those core FromSoftware ideas in a 2D game with progression in the style of Darkest Dungeon, I'm left eager to see what developer Melancholia Studio can achieve through its early access run.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Corpse Keeper 20% Off, Brand-New Challenge Mode Live Now!
notes.content:
Hi guys! We are very excited to announce that new update of Corpse Keeper is live now! In this new patch, we’ve added a brand-new [b]challenge mode[/b] to spice things up. Here you can be free of many restrictions and challenge various areas and bosses in one run.
To celebrate this major update, Corpse keeper will have a 20% discount from April 11 - 18. 

Please note that the current Challenge Mode is still in development and any feedback or suggestions are much appreciated! We'll keep adding content and optimizing the game. Please stay tuned!


[b]And here are some instructions of the Challenge Mode.[/b]

After obtaining two demon's soul crystals, you can enter the Challenge Mode through the door in the left corner of Ossuary.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304240/d315d3633a7dac972cf0ff658f29471d0e420973.png[/img]

Ossuary doesn’t exist in the Challenge Mode. You will need to select the areas and slash your way through, starting from Level 1. The number of challengeable areas is related to the current game level (for instance, at Level 1 you’ll need to select 1 area, at Level 5 you’ll have to select 5 areas). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304240/d1334da0c2b6931d4561a5aa06f36f87ad9f2752.jpg[/img]

Please check out the map design below. Pick your route carefully and defeat the boss in the final room!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304240/0acd55b0ed972dc822577714930074e36ad1fa64.png[/img]

Many new events have been added into the Challenge Mode. And the previous events are also a bit different from those of the regular game, e.g. the “Coffins” will also be a special event in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304240/2dec0a0da6b41f715e0c4ed62139ef1a8351a3d2.jpg[/img]

First of all, select 3 out of 4 corpses in the Coffin. The initial stats of the corpses, such as the Decay/Bone Injury/HP/EXP/Attack Actions, will be randomly generated based on the current area. 
And you can only select your corpses from the Coffins, but will not be able to heal/repair the bones/apply preservatives here. These functions shall be fulfilled by other "events" during your exploration.

In the Challenge Mode, there’s no backpack restriction. And you can change the corpses’ equipment whenever you want. The Decay of the corpses will be increased to a certain degree with each battle.


[b]*[/b]Right now, once you finish a round of challenge mode (successful or failed), your current save of the regular game will be reset. Therefore, we highly recommend that you experience the challenge mode after a round of regular game is finished. There'll be a notification inside the game regarding this situation as well. Please rest assured that we will be working on separating the save slots of these two modes to guarantee a better gaming experience. Thanks!


[b]Game Adjustment[/b]

-Replaced the "Inheritance Bottle" with the "Experience Bottle", with the effect of: Directly add 100 EXP to the corpse and increase the corpse’s Decay by 7%.

notes.title: Corpse Keeper Update 0225
notes.content:
In our previous update on Feb 17th, we made some restrictions on the magic skills of some enemies. However, we still received feedback saying that enemies were unreasonably chaining their ultimate moves. Upon inspecting the program code, we did discover some loopholes in the skill cooldowns that would cause the cooldown limitations to not function in certain situations. The latest update has fixed this bug and eliminated the situation where enemies can release the same magic skill consecutively for 3-4 times.

Currently, the rule of the enemies releasing the same magic skills is roughly that each magic attack has a cooldown of 6-7 seconds after being released twice. And this cooldown calculation is for individual magic skill only. For enemies with multiple magic skills, there will be separate rules to work out the cooldown for each skill release.

Previously we have discussed in the team whether to add cooldown immediately after an enemy releases a magic attack, which is more common in game design. However, considering that although the combat logic of Corpse Keeper is similar to Soulslike games like Sekiro or Dark Souls in a certain way (no combo design like fighting games, and the gameplay is more focused on observing enemy moves and avoiding being hit accordingly), the overall combat pace in Corpse Keeper is much faster with a higher frequency of transitioning between attack and defense. Therefore, we don't think it a good way to add cooldown after each magic skill of the enemies.

As for how to avoid being hit by magic attacks, each magic skill has a relatively easy-to-use avoidance strategy. For example, it's better to use side dodge to cope with "lightning wave" of the Magic Knight Lightning, while roll past him when his "thunderbolt" is in position. Those AOE skills (like the ring of fire and ice from the other magic knights) can only be avoided by distancing yourself from the enemy.

Different playable characters have distinct characteristics and it feels quite different when you try to dodge those magic skills when using different corpses. For characters like the Court Knight/Knight Cross Lance/Magic Knight Lightning & Ice with short back dash distance, it is very difficult to completely get out of the range of enemies' AOE attacks. However, for more agile characters like the Assassin, this will be much easier. Therefore, Assassins can fight up close, and get away unharmed if they retreat in time as the enemy begins to release magic.

The Knights, on the other hand, have an average back dash distance. You will need to maintain a certain distance from the enemy, be more cautious in their attacks, and closely observe the enemy's moves when using these characters. Sending the "correct" characters to fight different enemies is an important strategy in Corpse Keeper. If you feel that some certain enemies are very tricky, it might be a great idea to use another type of character to fight them.

Besides, the equipment in Corpse Keeper will also greatly enhance the strength of the characters, and using powerful equipment to directly confront bosses is also a viable option.

Here is a link to a video of a player using a Knight to challenge the Jester. This is an example of how to deal with a boss with AOE attacks without being fast or having powerful equipment: [url=https://youtu.be/MQqa-YEZdtQ]https://youtu.be/MQqa-YEZdtQ[/url]

But please rest assured that we will continue to optimize the enemies' combat design. Not only in terms of the skill cooldown, but also their damage, attack range, and attack windup of each skill, we will keeping conducting tests on our end to guarantee better gaming experiences for you.

Before we wrap things up, we just wanted to take a moment to say a massive THANK YOU to all the players out there! Your enthusiasm and support have been a constant source of inspiration to us. We hope you had as much fun playing as we did making it! If you've got any questions or feedback regarding our game, please feel free to drop us a message. Thanks!

Join our Discord: discord.gg/yKSBjxep7Z

notes.title: Death Cathedral NEW DEMO Live Now!
notes.content:
1. We have made some changes to our combat system in this new demo version: after killing the enemies, it’s possible to acquire new combat moves that could be edited to your combat sequence. Now you could actually build your own attack sequence! Besides, attack moves also got a level system.
2. Equipment won’t directly increase your basic attack power now. Attack power will be increased entirely through iterative attack moves. Some special facilities will be added to the game in future updates that can directly upgrade levels of the attack moves (this update might be happening during this particular testing period).
3. The game content you could experience this time is almost the same as the previous tests - you can play for 7 in-game days and encounter the first boss (Marshal).

Have fun in Death Cathedral!
